libs/api/core/feature/src/lib/api-core-f.uptime: Liveness probe. Returns process uptime only, no application data.

libs/api/custom/src/lib/plugins/auth/aut.login: Credential entry point. Cannot require an authenticated caller.
libs/api/custom/src/lib/plugins/auth/aut.complete2FALogin: Second leg of login. Authorized by the short-lived 2FA challenge token in the input.
libs/api/custom/src/lib/plugins/auth/aut.logout: Clears the caller's own session cookie. Nothing to read or escalate.
libs/api/custom/src/lib/plugins/auth/aut.register: Public signup. Rate limited by GqlThrottlerGuard.
libs/api/custom/src/lib/plugins/auth/aut.registerWithInvitation: Public signup. Authorized by the single-use invitation token in the input.
libs/api/custom/src/lib/plugins/auth/aut.forgotPassword: Pre-authentication recovery. Rate limited by GqlThrottlerGuard.
libs/api/custom/src/lib/plugins/auth/aut.resetPassword: Pre-authentication recovery. Authorized by the single-use reset token in the input.
libs/api/custom/src/lib/plugins/auth/aut.resendVerificationEmail: Pre-authentication recovery. Rate limited by GqlThrottlerGuard.
libs/api/custom/src/lib/plugins/auth/aut.verifyEmail: Reached from an emailed link before a session exists. Authorized by the token in the input.
libs/api/custom/src/lib/plugins/auth/aut.verifyEmailChange: Reached from an emailed link. Authorized by the single-use token argument.
libs/api/custom/src/lib/plugins/auth/aut.availableOAuthProviders: Renders the login screen's provider buttons. Returns static configuration, no user data.
libs/api/custom/src/lib/plugins/auth/aut.user: Field resolver on UserToken, which only a successful login issues. Resolved as part of the public login response; reaching it requires already holding that token.

libs/api/custom/src/lib/default/organiza.getInvitationDetails: Renders the invitation acceptance screen before the invitee has an account. Authorized by the invitation token argument.
